title: S102 later notes: registration re-check by name only; worktree assertions in the removal test

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S102 relay (run-20261026-193654-b9ea, landed b4b34fb). Owner decision 2026-10-29 (interactive): compare the registered path and drop the dead assertions. startRun's registration re-check matches by name only, so a project removed and re-added under the same name with a different path between planRun and startRun runs with a stale plan.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestStartRunRefusesAProjectReAddedUnderANewPath (same name, different path between plan and start is refused); TestStartRunRefusesAProjectRemovedAfterPlanning keeps its four live assertions and loses the unreachable worktree and git assertions (runs_test.go ~202-208).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Tests first; re-anchor line numbers from the code. 1. In startRun's registration re-check (runs.go ~490-492) compare find(f, name).Path with plan.project.Path as well as the name and refuse with the same error code the removed-project case uses. 2. In runs_test.go drop the worktree and git assertions that cannot fire (the worktree is created later in Run); keep the four assertions that catch the regression. No UI.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race -count=1 ./...; go vet ./...; gofmt -l .; slicer check; adj lint.
